guideBlocks.text: The post labels this a 2TAKE1 PS4 beta test. Its actual module is VOID_Beta_419.prx; an official 2Take1 release is not established. The included configuration names CUSA00419, but supplies no GTA V update. Confirm that missing requirement with the source before installing.

guideBlocks.title: Bundled installation guide

items.title: Choose the matching game build
items.text: Choose the ScorpionMenu-v1.2b-1xx.prx file matching your installed GTA V update. The source example uses ScorpionMenu-v1.2b-146.prx for GTA V 1.46. The archive includes labelled 100 EU, 100 US, 138, 143, 146, 148, 149 and 150 variants.

items.title: Transfer the plugin and data folder
items.text: Copy the selected PRX to /data/GoldHEN/plugins and the Scorpion folder to /data.

items.title: Merge the matching configuration
items.text: Edit your existing /data/GoldHEN/plugins.ini. Use your installed CUSA section and replace the example’s 150 filename with the exact selected build.

items: TRAINER INFO (read only): BE SURE TO READ ALL the comments where available. As a rule of thumb (for all games), ALWAYS enable only cheats that are needed and disable when they are not. You may need to enable Player-No-Dead cheat to prevent dying from fall damage when using the Moon/Super-Jump cheat. For an even more advanced trainer, check out my MultiTrainer2 ShnExt trainer. This trainer was made and tested on PS4 Firmware 9.00, but should also work on other firmwares. Credits: Some cheats were ported or derived from older game versions cheats made by TLH and/or Rizla and from the PC trainer made by FLiNG. Enjoy! ;-)

---One Hit Kill (requires MC): Using OHK on specific bosses, such as the first Goblin in Hogsmeade will cause progression issues. Also, deactive the cheat when practicing in Hogwarts, especially with dummies (eg. The Chinese chomping cabbage practice) as you may not be able to complete the training. If you get stuck after killing an enemy, disable OHK and reload the last save to complete the fight without it, then you may re-activate the cheat.

Infinite Ancient Magic: Using OHK on specific bosses, such as the first Goblin in Hogsmeade will cause progression issues. Also, deactive the cheat when practicing in Hogwarts, especially with dummies (eg. The Chinese chomping cabbage practice) as you may not be able to complete the training. If you get stuck after killing an enemy, disable OHK and reload the last save to complete the fight without it, then you may re-activate the cheat.
Infinite Items: Works for most items, including potions, resources etc
Infinite Items Usage: Takes effect when you use an item, the item amount won't decrease. Works for most usable items, such as potios.
Instant Brew Potions: Activate before brewing a potion.
Instant Grow Plants: Active before planting seeds.
---Ignore Conjuration Requirements (requires MC): When activated, you can craft items using the conjuring spell even if you don't have enough resources. If you do have resources, they will be used.

Teleport To Map Waypoint: Enable Infinite HP cheat as a precaution. After being teleported, wait a few seconds for rendering to complete. When its done, press X + DPAD DOWN to continue. If you get teleported BELOW THE MAP after the game completes rendering, first press X + DPAD UP to lift you above the map and then press X + DPAD DOWN to continue. If for any reason you end up falling infinitely below the map, exit the game and re-launch it. AVOID teleporting yourself to places that are still locked, which you are not suppose to be able to reach yet, as this may cause game progession issue or other issues. DOESNT WORK IN FLY MODE.

---Unlock All Fast Travel Locations (requires MC): When activated, you can fast travel to any fast travel locations, even if they're still locked. If you fast traveled to a locked location, it will then be unlocked.

Stealth Mode: Enemies will be able to see you only after they get attacked. Note that this cheat has not been thoroughly tested and might cause progression issues, especially in case a fight is required to progress, thus enemies need to detect you first (boss fights likely).In such cases, you may need to disable the cheat and continue or restart from the last checkpoint with the cheat disabled.

Undetectable: Enemies can not detect you and will not attack back when being hit. Note that this cheat has not been thoroughly tested and might cause progression issues, especially in case a fight is required to progress, thus enemies need to detect you first (boss fights likely). In such cases, you may need to disable the cheat and continue or restart from the last checkpoint with the cheat disabled.
0 Quidditch Trial Timer: Scoreboard will display 1 Second

Gain Max Money (READ INFO): When activated, shop items will cost negative money, which mean you will gain money when buying from shops. This is a one time use cheat. Be sure to enable it ONLY right before starting shopping and disable it immediately after completing shopping. Do not enable the cheat after gaining sufficient funds. 10 million coins are usually enough for the entire game.
99 Talent Points: Takes effect when you open the Talents menu or when you spend talent points.

guideBlocks.title: Included installation instructions

items.title: Check the installed game
items.text: The archive and module name GTA V 1.57. The example configuration names CUSA00419; other regional title IDs and PS5 support are not established.

items.text: Extract the original archive on your computer. Its installation note places the Crystalis folder under /data, giving /data/Crystalis. Preserve scripts, outfits and imgs. The note says img, but the actual archive and module both use /data/Crystalis/imgs/icon.png.

items.title: Place the module
items.text: The supplied note places Crystalis.sprx in /data/GoldHEN/plugins/. Use a GoldHEN plugin environment compatible with your existing PS4 firmware. This SPRX is a game plugin, not a standalone BIN/ELF payload.

items.title: Merge your configuration
items.text: Back up your existing plugins.ini. Merge the Crystalis path into the matching CUSA00419 section instead of replacing the whole file. The supplied example also lists LSOPlugin.prx, which is not included; its necessity is not documented. Preserve your unrelated plugin entries.

guideBlocks.title: Game update and server availability
guideBlocks.text: The ZIP contains separate 1.56/GTARBN.sprx and 1.57/GTARBN.sprx files. Choose the exact folder for your installed GTA V update. The supplied server announcement explicitly says “FOR 1.57 ONLY”; preserving the 1.56 client is not confirmation of current 1.56 server access. No PS5 or firmware compatibility is established.

guideBlocks.title: Register and install

items.title: Register yourself in GTA Reborn Discord
items.text: Use the server’s bot command /link username:YOUR_GAMERTAG. Replace YOUR_GAMERTAG with your PSN name exactly as it appears on your console, including letter case. The supplied instructions allow one registration per Discord account; each player registers from their own account.

items.title: Save your personal registration file
items.text: The bot replies privately with Reborn.txt. Copy that exact file to /data/Reborn.txt on your PS4. It is not included in this download and must come from your own registration. The supplied instructions say there is no in-game registration.

items.title: Install the matching client
items.text: With GTA V closed, copy the 1.56 client to /data/GoldHEN/plugins/GTARBN.sprx. The original ZIP contains both updates under different folders; the standalone download on this card is already the 1.56 file. Keep the other build separate rather than overwriting it by shared filename.

items.title: Merge plugins.ini
items.text: Choose your installed title ID in the region selector. Merge the generated section into /data/GoldHEN/plugins.ini and retain unrelated entries. Regional configurations are templates: embedded CUSA00419 request text does not establish a complete EU/USA compatibility matrix.

items.title: Launch the server client
items.text: Start GTA Online with the correct Reborn plugin loaded and follow the server’s instructions. The supplied setup says a missing or incomplete /data/Reborn.txt prevents patches from being applied. Confirm that the client works before adding Ozark.

guideBlocks.title: Registration command from the supplied instructions
guideBlocks.text: /link username:YOUR_GAMERTAG

guideBlocks.title: Required PS4 paths
guideBlocks.text:
/data/Reborn.txt
/data/GoldHEN/plugins/GTARBN.sprx
/data/GoldHEN/plugins.ini

guideBlocks.title: Ozark setup
guideBlocks.text: This Ozark setup requires the matching GTA Reborn client. Ozark 1.56 combined downloads include this exact 1.56 Reborn module and an INI with both plugin paths. Your personal Reborn.txt is still required; it is never generated or included by the website.

guideBlocks.title: Other commands in the supplied guide
items: /playersonline [minutes] lists recently active players; the supplied default is 15 minutes. Example: /playersonline minutes:60.
/viewcrews lists available crews. /createcrew creates a crew with name and tag, plus optional motto, colour, owner, public/private setting and icon.
/linkcrew crew:TAG assigns a crew; the supplied instructions also accept its name or crew_id.

guideBlocks.title: Troubleshooting from the supplied guide
items: Cannot join: check registration with /link and the presence of /data/Reborn.txt.
Patches were not applied: the supplied guide says Reborn.txt is absent or incomplete; retrieve your own file from the bot’s private reply.
Misspelled PSN name: contact the GTA Reborn server team to correct registration; do not register a friend from your account.
